detail.title: WAKE✳︎ Research Journal: Scrambling and Objectivity
detail.summary: This journal entry revises the analysis of how scrambling dynamics interact with environmental decoherence to permit objective records. The revision synthesizes new findings on open system master equations and operational definitions of objectivity, formalizing the distinction between delocalized quantum information and the redundancy necessary for public, observer-accessible records.
